notes.text: The page is a handwritten working sheet. It has an underlined Cor heading, an underlined definition heading, displayed labels (*) and (21), and a pencil archive number 36 at the lower left. No author-written page number, date, or separate title was observed.

The opening discusses Card with visibly empty braces and four signed Sigma ensembles. A raised addition contributes the two displayed exclusion conditions. The diagonal passage begins “Sous forme :” and reformulates the preceding discussion; its short forms and raised contraction are retained.

The proof text begins “En effet” and includes “par hypothèse”, “car on aurait”, and “Il reste à voir”. These phrases are reported as the author’s own wording. No proof or mathematical implication was independently checked in this page-reading task.

The middle passage explicitly refers to “le diagramme (14)”. No diagram is drawn on this page and no other page was opened. The interlinear “la première p. ex.” attaches to the conclusion word group; the live word is signifierait, while the later Sigma equation and the short link on the next line are cancelled. The conclusion ends “ce que l’on a exclu”.

The lower definition visibly uses “strictement non panachées”. Its raised addition repeats “non panachées”. A long vertical line marks the definition at the left. The bottom display carries label (21), the author’s parenthesis “on dit donc que ... sont propres”, and the E_1/E_2 comparisons. The physical bottom edge is close to the lowest descenders.

The top-shaped superscripts are recorded from their cap and descending-stem form. The same page also has plus signs with visible upper arms. No interpretation of the top-shaped sign, and no repair based on the surrounding formulae, was used. Similarly, the four-member ordering was not used to supply uncertain low indices.

H’s explicit notes were checked. They acknowledge the top exclusion addition, the diagonal note, the interlinear la première p. ex., the long vertical line, and the definition’s added condition. Those acknowledged placements do not produce H collation rows. H’s note about the revised conclusion was compared with the actual leader and strike positions. Its em-phasis syntax was treated as an author-emphasis convention; differences in literal macro names were not counted.

The supplied C note and doubt table were used only as comparison targets. The transcribed glyphs and words were read from the whole page, both halves, and the individual enhanced crops. No previously unseen mathematical result was asserted, no conjecture was proposed, and no conditional theorem was formulated.
